fusions.name: Stinging Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stinging darts in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Balling Burst
fusions.desc: Sends a balled-up swarm into the first enemy it meets. It bursts for 30 damage, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Tireless Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and raises your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hive Tempo
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
